'''2020 TMW Pods Matt Sperling LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sperling]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Sperling]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Roo Sperli.txt |Download]]
